knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The assessment and training come first. Willingness and tape do not meet the requirement.
Stop, restrict and refer. Home treatment and delay are not acceptable.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional PPE request, the learner states which assessment, training and fit checks must be in place before entry. Pass: all three are named.
The learner writes the stop-and-refer steps for a suspected exposure, in order. Pass: stop, restrict, refer and record all appear in order.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: PPE is not selected by an assessment.
Training or fit is not confirmed.
